0022600147.text: The Utah Jazz, 1-4 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Portland Trail Blazers in their sixth game of the 2026-27 season, with Utah 13th in the West and fifth in the Northwest, three games back. Portland comes in 3-0, first in the Northwest and second in the West, on a three-game winning streak, and has one more game to play before this one. Out for Utah are Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee), Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), and Trey Alexander (knee bruise), while Lauri Markkanen is day-to-day with a wrist injury and a game-time decision; Portland is missing Chris Youngblood (ankle soreness), Robert Williams III (knee), and Shaedon Sharpe (knee surgery). The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost all four meetings to Portland, most recently 124-114 in Portland on March 13, 2026.
